    /**

    }

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'Converts explicit variables in double-quoted strings and heredoc syntax from simple to complex format (`${` to `{$`).',

                        $name = 'World';
                        echo "Hello ${name}!";

                        EOT

                new CodeSample(

                        <?php
                        $name = 'World';
                        echo <<<TEST

    public function processOverloadedBraces(Tokens $tokens, Token $token, int $index): void

    public function processOverloadedSquareBraces(Tokens $tokens, Token $token, int $index): void

    public function isShortArrayOpening(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {

        if (!$this->squareCollection instanceof Tokens) {
            return false;
        }
        $result = $this->isShortArrayOpeningAt($index);
        $this->clearSquareContext();

    public function convertImplicitStringVariables(Tokens $tokens): void
    {

                continue;

            $this->collectEmbeddedVariables($index);

    {

        }

        if (!$this->braceCollection instanceof Tokens) {

    private function transformIntoDollarCloseBrace(Token $token): void

            return false;
        }

        return $token->isGivenKind(T_DOLLAR_OPEN_CURLY_BRACES);
    }

    private function transformIntoDynamicPropBraces(Token $token): void

        if (!$this->braceCollection instanceof Tokens) {

    {
        if (!$this->braceCollection instanceof Tokens) {

        if (!$token->isObjectOperator()) {
            return false;
        }

        $tokens = $this->braceTokens();

    private function transformIntoDynamicVarBraces(Token $token): void

        if (!$this->braceCollection instanceof Tokens) {

        if (!$this->canOpenDynamicVarBrace($token)) {

        $openIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($this->braceCursor);

    private function canOpenDynamicVarBrace(Token $token): bool
    {
        if (!$this->braceCollection instanceof Tokens) {
            return false;
        }

        }

        $tokens = $this->braceTokens();
        $openIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($this->braceCursor);
        if (null === $openIndex) {
            return false;
        }

        return $tokens[$openIndex]->equals('{');
    }

    private function transformIntoCurlyIndexBraces(Token $token): void
    {
        if (!$this->braceCollection instanceof Tokens) {
            throw new \LogicException('Token collection is not available.');

        if (!$this->predecessorSupportsCurlyIndex()) {
            return;
        }

        $closeIndex = $this->naivelyFindCurlyBlockEnd($this->braceCursor);
        $this->assignBracePair($this->braceCursor, $closeIndex, CT::T_ARRAY_INDEX_CURLY_BRACE_OPEN, CT::T_ARRAY_INDEX_CURLY_BRACE_CLOSE);

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `applyFix` of `src/Fixer/StringNotation/SimpleToComplexStringVariableFixer.php:1568-1593`: it only handled `${var}` when the closing brace immediately followed the varname (`$index + 2`), so `${name[0]}` and `${name['key']}` were skipped.

The fix:
- Added `findDollarCloseBraceIndex()` which scans forward from the varname for `CT::T_DOLLAR_CLOSE_CURLY_BRACES` (tracking square-bracket nesting), instead of assuming the close is at `$index + 2`.
- The replacement now preserves the in-between tokens (`[`, index/key, `]`) between `{$name` and `}`.

Verified:
- Both reproducer cases from the issue now convert correctly (`{$name[0]}`, `{$name['key']}`)
- All 18 tests in `SimpleToComplexStringVariableFixerTest` and the full `tests/Fixer/StringNotation/` suite (421 tests) pass, including regression cases (escaped `\$`, double-dollar, heredoc)
- The `tests/Tokenizer/TokensTest` failure is pre-existing (missing constant on unmodified code)
